registry_source: The KMIALL snapshot this repo tracks (src/data/universe_kmiall.json, members with listedIn containing KMIALLSHR), read against the exchange's own instrument names. Two basket instruments are listed there as Shariah constituents.
coverage_note: The registry is the reviewed half of the exclusion; the other half is the exchange's ETF naming convention (every PSX exchange traded fund's tape symbol ends in ETF), applied by src/data/eligibility.py. A symbol whose classification neither half settles is UNKNOWN and is refused, never admitted.

MIIETF.source: src/data/universe_kmiall.json 2026-10-15, listedIn KMIALLSHR; PSX symbol ends in ETF
MIIETF.note: An index tracking fund. It rides the index rather than showing its own momentum, so it is not intraday material.

MZNPETF.source: src/data/universe_kmiall.json 2026-10-15, listedIn KMIALLSHR; PSX symbol ends in ETF
MZNPETF.note: The Meezan Pakistan ETF, the same basket problem as MIIETF.
